proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL caṭaka subsection 1 gives Nepali caro bird/cari small bird, Kumaoni caṛo/caṛi and the -āka extension Bengali caṛāi, Oriya caṛāi and Assamese sarāi. The selected ca-/cə-/co-/tsa- survey bird forms follow this branch. Preserve source affricate and aspiration notation, schwa/o vowels and dental/retroflex/rhotic differences; the source bird sense is not narrowed to sparrow. Local IA transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: cərā.
